usage.callShape: POST https://webhook-tester.api.klymax402.com/api/test with JSON body {url, method, body} where url is the target webhook to test
usage.outputShape: body.response.statusCode, body.response.statusText, body.response.headers, body.response.body, body.latencyMs, body.success; echoes body.requestBody and body.requestHeaders
quirks: Body field is 'url' = the target webhook to probe (not the API's own URL); supply 'method' and optional 'body' for the test request.
Response is sync JSON; the probed endpoint's result lives under body.response (statusCode/headers/body) and timing under body.latencyMs.
usage.guide: POST to https://webhook-tester.api.klymax402.com/api/test with a JSON body {"url": "<target webhook URL>", "method": "POST", "body": {...}} and pay $0.002 USDC via x402 on Base. The service fires the request at your target URL and returns a sync JSON analysis. Read the probed result from body.response (statusCode, statusText, headers, body) and the round-trip time from body.latencyMs; body.success indicates whether the call completed. It echoes your requestBody/requestHeaders so you can confirm what was sent.
